title: Host a Game Hours
description: Organize and host a small Game Hours activity for SpoonOS community members.
requirements: Submit the game and activity plan in advance | Publish the event notice | Host the activity for at least 30 minutes | Submit a recap with attendance and feedback | The activity must be open to community members
review_criteria: The event was properly announced | The host actively organized and guided the session | Participants had a clear way to join | The recap records outcomes and feedback
required_evidence: Event announcement link | Game Hours channel or voice activity link | Screenshot of activity | Recap and participant feedback
disqualifiers: Cancelled or unhosted event | Event shorter than the minimum duration | Self-reported attendance without evidence | Repeated low-effort sessions
topic_definition: Lightweight multiplayer games or social activities that help community members interact and get to know each other
positive_examples: A beginner-friendly game with clear rules | A session with team rotation and a short feedback form | A member-led game night with a useful recap
negative_examples: Posting a game suggestion without hosting | Joining another person's session | A private session with no community participation

title: Participate in a Game Hours
description: Join and actively participate in an official SpoonOS Game Hours session.
requirements: The participant must join an official Game Hours session | The participant must stay for at least 30 minutes or until the session ends | The participant must actively participate in the game | One reward per session | Passive attendance does not qualify
review_criteria: The participant joined the correct session | The participation duration meets the minimum requirement | The participant was actively involved in the activity
required_evidence: Activity announcement link | Screenshot of participation or activity log | Host confirmation or participant list
disqualifiers: Joining without participating | Leaving before the minimum duration | Fake or edited screenshots | Claiming the same session more than once | Participating in an unofficial private game session
topic_definition: Official community gaming sessions organized through the SpoonOS Game Hours channel
positive_examples: Joining the scheduled game and playing with community members | Participating in team activities and completing the session | Sharing a short activity reflection after the session
negative_examples: Posting a game suggestion only | Joining the voice channel but remaining inactive | Watching without participating | Submitting only a message reaction

title: Win a Game Hours
description: Win an official SpoonOS Game Hours game or competition and receive the winner reward.
requirements: The participant must join an official Game Hours session | The participant must be declared a winner by the host | The winning result must be verifiable | One winner reward per session unless multiple winners are announced in advance | The participant must not claim both winner and participation rewards for the same session
review_criteria: The participant joined the official session | The winner status is confirmed by the host or official result | The evidence matches the claimed session and account
required_evidence: Activity announcement link | Screenshot of final result or game ranking | Host confirmation or official winner announcement
disqualifiers: Unverified winner claim | Edited or misleading evidence | Winning an unofficial private game | Claiming the same win multiple times | Claiming both participation and winner rewards for the same session
topic_definition: Official Game Hours competitions, matches, tournaments, or games with a verifiable result
positive_examples: Being announced as the winning player or team | Winning a documented tournament round | Receiving confirmation from the official host
negative_examples: Participating without winning | Self-declared victory without confirmation | Winning outside the official activity | Submitting a screenshot with no identifiable session

title: Follow the Official Medium Account
description: Follow the official SpoonOS Medium account (https://medium.com/@SpoonOS) and submit verifiable proof.
requirements: The member must follow the official SpoonOS Medium account | The screenshot must show the account identity and following status | One reward per account
review_criteria: The official account and member account must be identifiable | The following status must be verifiable
required_evidence: Official Medium account link | Screenshot showing the following status | Public profile link where applicable
disqualifiers: Following an unofficial account | Unidentifiable screenshot | Duplicate submission | Claiming through multiple accounts
positive_examples: Following the official account and submitting a screenshot showing the following status
negative_examples: Only opening an article | Liking an article without following | Screenshot without an identifiable account or following status

title: Join the Official Reddit Community
description: Join the official SpoonOS Reddit community (https://www.reddit.com/r/SpoonOSAI/) and submit verifiable proof.
requirements: The member must join the official Reddit community | The account must be verifiable | One reward per account
review_criteria: The community link and account identity must be clearly verifiable | The submission must prove that the member joined
required_evidence: Reddit community link | Account screenshot or public profile URL
disqualifiers: Joining an unofficial community | Unidentifiable screenshot | Duplicate submission | Claiming through multiple accounts
positive_examples: Joining the official community and submitting public account proof
negative_examples: Only visiting the community page | No verifiable proof | Duplicate claim

title: Comment on a Designated Reddit Post
description: Leave a meaningful and relevant comment under a designated post in the official SpoonOS Reddit community.
requirements: The comment must be submitted under a designated Reddit post | The comment must directly respond to the topic | It must provide a specific opinion, additional information, question, or suggestion | Agreement-only comments do not qualify | The same post cannot be counted more than once
review_criteria: The comment is relevant to the designated post | It adds meaningful discussion value | The content is specific and understandable | The comment is not copied or repetitive
required_evidence: Designated post URL | Comment URL or screenshot | Supporting reference where applicable
disqualifiers: Substantive-free comments such as Nice, Great, or Thanks | Emoji-only comments | Repeated comments | Advertising | Off-topic replies | Generic AI-generated replies
topic_definition: Designated discussion posts about SpoonOS, AI, agents, product experience, technical topics, or community activities
positive_examples: A specific response to the author's question | An additional use case or practical suggestion | A detailed follow-up question | A verified technical reference
negative_examples: Generic agreement | Emoji-only reply | Repeating the original post | Link-only reply | Irrelevant promotion

title: Publish an Original Reddit Post
description: Publish an original post related to SpoonOS, AI, agents, or relevant technical topics in the official SpoonOS Reddit community.
requirements: The post must contain an original perspective, first-hand experience, or specific question | The content must be relevant to the community | The post must be publicly visible | Duplicate or directly copied content does not qualify
review_criteria: The content must be original and useful for discussion | The background and perspective must be clear | The post should encourage meaningful participation
required_evidence: Reddit post URL | Publication screenshot | Supporting material or product evidence where applicable
disqualifiers: Link-only or image-only post | Pure promotion | Copied content | Generic AI-generated content | Irrelevant content | Spam
topic_definition: Original product experience, technical perspective, real question, use case, or community discussion topic
positive_examples: A post with clear context, a specific perspective, and a discussion question | A real product usage experience | A practical technical observation
negative_examples: Generic greetings or praise | Copied official announcement | AI-generated article without a personal perspective | Duplicate post
